newsitem.title: USA: Vehicle location company to sell $100 mln in units.
newsitem.headline: Vehicle location company to sell $100 mln in units.

text.p: TeleTrac Inc , a startup company that provides wireless technology for locating vehicles and managing fleets, plans to sell $100 million in units in a 144a private placement via Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette and TD Securities, according to a confidential prospectus obtained by Reuters.
The company, which is based in Kansas City, Missouri, will use the proceeds from the offering to build its network.
Teletrac offers two-way digital wireless messaging to commercial fleet operators. It also provides vehicle location and stolen vehicle recovery services to consumers via a proprietary service.
The units will consist of 10-year senior notes and warrants to purchase class A shares of Teletrac Holdings Inc, Teletrac's parent company.
The senior notes will include a three-year prefunded interest reserve.
The offering is expected to price in July, market sources said.
